name: Inventory with purchase-to-usage units
proof: Buy in packs or bags while stock and recipes stay accurate in the unit actually consumed.

name: Dashboard search and operating insights
proof: Search key business records quickly and review stock, commercial and period signals from one operating dashboard.

name: Persistent stock alerts inside the shared operations tray
proof: Raw-material and finished-good warning/low conditions open in separate Inventory tabs inside the movable tray, keep per-user snooze/re-alert timing, can use synthesized alerts or eight bundled audio chimes, and continue due reminders through Web Push when the app is backgrounded or closed.

name: Business-defined product categories
audience: retail, restaurant, bakery and wholesale teams
proof: Organize sellable products independently of whether they are made in-house or purchased for resale.

name: Controlled measurement changes
proof: Convert live stock and recipe definitions without rewriting completed historical evidence.

name: Procurement and receiving
proof: Receive purchase orders into stock with unit conversion and cost updates handled together.

name: Wholesale and retail stock-first workflows
proof: Wholesale and retail use procurement-first stock-product forms and supporting-supply controls without production-only recipe, batch or base-material fields.

name: Production requests and orders
proof: Plan output, release recipe materials transactionally and add completed output to finished stock.

name: Shared Production Runs
proof: Coordinate multiple normal customer/restock orders into one combined material release without losing order-level attribution.

name: Batch yield, wastage and output tracking
proof: Keep requested quantity, planned output, actual output and wastage distinct.

name: Offcut, surplus and shortage reconciliation
proof: Route usable surplus deliberately and reconcile customer shortages without duplicate sales or production events.

name: Customer orders and sales
proof: Handle walk-in and customer orders while preserving fulfilment and payment state separately.

name: Customer and channel pricing
proof: Resolve customer-specific pricing before channel pricing, then fall back to the product default.

name: Receivables, payables and partial settlement
proof: Track what is owed separately from real cash movement and support partial settlement without false paid states.

name: Auditable cash and finance ledger
proof: Verified money movement posts to tenant-owned accounts with compensating reversals instead of destructive edits.

name: Expenses and expense settlement
proof: Record business expenses, distinguish unpaid obligations from actual settlement, and feed paid amounts into the cash ledger.

name: Staff payroll add-on with shareable payslips
proof: Link existing INPROFIC users or add non-user staff, configure pay structures plus tax, pension and other calculation rules, then issue frozen-detail payslips that can be shared by email or WhatsApp.

name: Hosted storefront, product choices, variants and add-ons
audience: businesses selling online without a custom commerce stack
proof: Publish tenant products with channel-safe pricing and group separately stocked, priced and produced size variants under one storefront card. Each product can offer a no-price-change choice such as flavor or color; separately priced add-ons remain their own basket lines. Customers choose available stock or made-to-order fulfilment, review readiness, and create operational orders only after verified payment.

name: Headless Commerce API
audience: businesses with custom websites or apps
proof: External websites consume authoritative catalogue, fulfilment-choice/readiness, checkout, payment, API-native receipt, delivery conversation/reporting and tracking endpoints without redirecting customers into the hosted storefront.

name: Paystack and Monnify payments
proof: Provider-backed checkout and instant transfer settle only after authoritative provider verification.

name: Manual transfer routes (no gateway)
audience: businesses that prefer direct bank transfer
proof: Offer one or more business transfer accounts, let hosted/headless customers choose the destination, require payment proof externally, and keep payment pending until staff verifies the actual credit.

name: In-premise POS
audience: cashiers, stores, restaurants and walk-in operations
proof: Staff can complete counter sales with Cash, direct Transfer or supported terminal payment only when the tenant plan includes Commerce and Commerce is explicitly enabled; POS still keeps its dedicated user permission.

name: Delivery quoting and hybrid routing
proof: Quote from validated destinations before payment, batch multiple customer orders onto one in-house rider, require route organisation before pickup, and start stop-aware customer ETA countdowns when pickup makes the rider en route.

name: Mapped delivery areas and precise address validation
proof: Define delivery coverage, locate typed addresses after a calm 2-second idle window, keep corrections from being overwritten by stale lookups, and fall back to a customer map pin before quoting delivery.

name: Provider-neutral delivery partner adapters
audience: businesses using in-house riders, couriers or external delivery partners
proof: Keep INPROFIC in control of delivery pricing, routing and tracking while any courier stays manual or connects through a normalized dispatch/status adapter; optional built-in providers remain separately governed.

name: Shared realtime Commerce, Inventory and Finance alert tray
proof: Commerce, payment, Delivery, Inventory and Finance attention share one movable access-aware tray without merging their underlying record state; completed orders raise a persistent delivery-ready handoff for dispatch staff and can use durable Web Push even while INPROFIC is closed, while Finance surfaces unpaid invoices, receivables, payables and balancing anomalies from the same finance records.

name: Delivery Rider workspace
proof: Riders see only assigned deliveries, can organise multi-order pickup routes, start pickup-and-en-route ETA countdowns, exchange delivery-scoped messages with customers that dispatch staff can also see, and complete proof-of-delivery actions.

name: Storefront customer profiles and tracking
proof: Optional tenant-scoped customer accounts save contact details and purchase history while guest checkout remains available.

name: Audit Workspace
audience: owners, finance teams and external auditors
proof: Provide plan-gated read-only cross-module evidence review with auditor queries, flags and response tracking.

name: Role and per-user permissions
proof: Give staff only the workspaces and actions they need while business-level entitlements remain the ceiling.

name: Tenant branding and workspace appearance
proof: Business accent/background branding and light/dark workspace preferences keep each tenant recognizable without changing operational data.

name: Founder-controlled subscription plans & trial policy
proof: Control plan pricing, module entitlements, the general free-trial duration and per-business founder trial extensions without deleting tenant history or overlapping active paid/lifetime access.

name: Founder-controlled third-party integration availability
audience: INPROFIC platform operators and businesses using optional delivery providers
proof: Optional provider connectors can be hidden and execution-blocked platform-wide without deleting tenant credentials or history; businesses still activate their own approved provider accounts only after configuration.

name: Multiple service/business profiles under one subscription
audience: owners running more than one service line
proof: Provision additional tenant-isolated service profiles, carry appropriate memberships across, and switch between them without mixing records.

name: Plan-upgrade data continuity
proof: Hidden interconnected modules do not stop required back-office synchronization, so upgrades reveal already-complete records.

name: Reports, exports and business backup
proof: Generate a date-range monthly PDF with revenue, sales-origin, procurement, production and inventory charts and tables, alongside exports and a tenant backup.

name: Guided system onboarding
proof: A replayable tenant-aware tour keeps the original animated guide and adds a second module-specific preview that reflects the business vertical.

name: Surface-safe Online, POS and Distribution pricing
audience: businesses selling both in-premise and online
proof: Physical Store/direct pricing stays inside the staff POS, while hosted/headless commerce exposes Online plus Distribution/Bulk and INPROFIC enforces the chosen channel and minimum quantity server-side.

name: Standard portions, composed products and Bulk Packs
audience: restaurants and production businesses selling in customer-friendly portions or bulk packs
proof: Keep production in base units such as scoops/pieces/ml while customers buy plates, servings, bowls, cartons or other packs; show customer-safe package contents and preserve private yield conversions.

name: Founder product and lead analytics
proof: Track first-party signup leads, completed registrations, logins, subscription milestones and throttled module usage in Founder Console, with retained deleted-state and permanent-removal controls for signup mailing-list entries, without recording passwords, payment secrets or arbitrary clickstreams.

name: Animated, consistent form validation across INPROFIC
proof: HTML5 and Django validation share animated field states, contextual SVG affordances, accessible feedback and consistent toggle switches; dynamic rows inherit the same behavior.

name: Channel-aware plain and add-on product options
audience: restaurants and production businesses selling composed products plus extras
proof: Offer Extra Jollof, Single Chicken, bottles, pieces or other plain portions from the same Finished Good stock and recipe with independent Physical Store, Online and Bulk/Distribution availability and pricing.

name: Interactive product demos
proof: The marketing site provides a vertical-aware workflow, a floating module constellation with flowing brand connectors and viewport-centred previews, plus a detailed storefront-to-fulfilment flow.

name: Targeted business mailing workspace
proof: Create reusable branded email topics, segment current businesses by service and plan, send immediately, and retry provider failures safely with per-recipient delivery totals.

name: Founder-managed trusted-business strip
proof: Show a founder-enabled scrolling logo strip above the product demo, automatically limiting tenant logos to paid businesses while the animated platform count includes trials and approved manual logos fill gaps.

name: Online stock-or-made fulfilment choice
audience: businesses selling online from both ready stock and production
proof: Customers can choose available Physical Store stock or made-to-order fulfilment per Online line while Online pricing stays unchanged; readiness is shown per product and checkout uses the slowest line.

name: Routed multi-order rider batches
proof: Assign multiple customer orders to one rider, organise stop order before pickup, start pickup-and-en-route countdowns together, and keep each customer on a stop-adjusted ETA with active delivery messaging visible to dispatch.
